test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (1 and 2) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

1. Stonehenge is a historic site in southern England.

A. It is a religious shrine.

B. At first there was only a circular mound.

C. This was dug in 1900 BC.

D. The familiar circle of giant stones was added 400 years later.

2. These stones weighed about 26 tons each.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ABCD"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sentence 1, mentions the subject i.e. the historic site of "Stonehenge" in southern England.
 
• Further, sentence A provides additional information about the purpose of Stonehenge.
 
• Sentence B talks about the initial state of the site, which is a logical continuation of sentence C.
 
• Further, sentence C talks about the circular mound being dug in 1900 BC, which sets the context for the paragraph.
 
• Sentence D talks about the addition of the giant stones, which is later discussed in sentence 2.
 
• Thus, the correct order of the given sentences will be "ABCD."

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (CDBA) **starts with the same sentence as the correct answer, but then jumps to sentence D, which disrupts the flow of the paragraph.
 
• **Option 2 (BCDA) **starts with the same sentence as the correct answer, but then jumps to sentence B, which is out of place.
 
• **Option 4 (DBAC) **starts with the last sentence of the paragraph, which is not a good starting point for a coherent paragraph.
